newsitem.title: USA: Poll suggests Miami arena funding plan could fail.
newsitem.headline: Poll suggests Miami arena funding plan could fail.

text.p: A poll conducted for Miami Herald and NBC shows 48 percent of the resondents oppose using public money to build a new waterfront arena for the Miami Heat basketball team, while only 36 percent support the plan.
Sixteen percent were undecided, according to poll results published Wednesday in the Herald.

Voters will decide Tuesday whether Dade County should issue revenue bonds for the $168 million facility. Debt service would be paid with hotel and sales tax revenues and a $50 million payment for the team.
Asked if they would support a privately funded arena on the same waterfront park land, 71 percent of respondents said yes, 20 percent said no and 9 percent were undecided.
The poll of 696 randomly selected likely voters was conducted by Gonzalez and Greer Research Associates and has an error margin of 4 percent.
